₹5,000 ka loss → ₹20,000 ka trade? 🛑 RUKO!

Revenge trading ka maths:
−10% gaya → wapas aane ke liye +11% chahiye
−50% gaya → +100% chahiye 😬

Rule: market khulne se pehle din ka MAX LOSS fix karo. Hit hua → app band, uth jaao.

Save karo, agle loss wale din kaam aayega. Kabhi loss wapas jeetne ki koshish ki hai? 👇
